title: The Social Laboratory: A Psychometric Framework for Multi-Agent LLM Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Quantified the presence of general social bias in multi-agent debate arguments using a binary classification (0 or 1) generated by a specialized Qwen3-4B-BiasExpert model, which tracks average bias scores and bias amplification trends per round.

Conducted a qualitative case study analysis evaluating the multi-agent system's ability to de-bias a conversation when provided with an explicitly racist initial prompt, measured via the reduction of the per-round Bias Score.

Conducted a qualitative case study analysis observing polarization and bias amplification on a contentious topic regarding film critics and ideology, measured via increasing per-round Bias Scores throughout the debate.
